messages.author: 453ddfeccaf29bbb
messages.subject: a question from genna gliner on advi in rstan
parts:
I followed the directions to uninstall and then reinstall, but can't seem to get rid of the error.  


I am working on fitting an overdispersed Poisson model and when I go to fit the model it runs fine, converges, samples, and then leaves me with the following error before assigning the variable:

Drawing 1000 samples from the approximate posterior... COMPLETED.

Error in result[[i]] : subscript out of bounds

The script with no modifications has run successfully in the past and I can recreate the error over several datasets. This variable isn't in my workspace.  Could you shed any light on the error? 


I have provided a minimal working example below, an attached RData file, and the output of  sessionInfo().


-Genna


library(rstan)


load('stantest.RData')

 N = length(unique(data$SUBJECT_ID))

 P = length(unique(data$VARIANT_ID))

total = nrow(data)

offset = rep(1,P) #sum the total counts for each snp

X = as.numeric(data$HAP)

Y = data$COUNT

print("running stan")

print(P)

print(N)

fit1 <- vb(modFit, data = list(Y = Y, X = X, total = total, 

               person = data$person_num, snp = data$snp_num, P = P, N = N, 

               offset = offset, hyperpars = c(.0001,.0001)),

               pars = c("beta","sigma", "beta_0"), include = TRUE,

                #seed = char2seed(tissue),

                output_samples=1000)

parts: I just had the same error.

> Drawing 1000 samples from the approximate posterior... COMPLETED.
> Error in result[[i]] : subscript out of bounds

I'd normally use sampling, but this is a simple stan_lmer with 10k random effects and a few million observations. 

Any tips?

On Thursday, July 28, 2016 at 12:22:04 PM UTC-4, Ben Goodrich wrote:
On Thursday, July 28, 2016 at 11:56:41 AM UTC-4, Bob Carpenter wrote:
Thanks for reporting.  And just a heads up.  There was a bug
introduced in the new sampler in 2.10 that is fixed
in the pending 2.11 release.

Although that wouldn't affect ADVI. I am not getting this error. It may be due to the fact that standata.RData loads a compiled stanmodel called modFit, which is not binary compatible across computers. I had to recompile that, and then it was fine.
